statement: Between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-07, a single Russian air attack (missile, drone, or glide bomb) on one Ukrainian city or town kills at least 10 people.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP, citing Ukrainian national or regional officials, report one Russian air attack on a single Ukrainian city or town between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-07 with a death toll of at least 10.
failure_condition: No single Russian air attack on one Ukrainian city or town between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-07 kills 10 or more people.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-08 and 2026-12-31, the US and Iranian governments both publicly announce or confirm a ceasefire or agreement ending hostilities between the United States and Iran.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-10-08 and 2026-12-31, the US government and the Iranian government each publicly announce or confirm a ceasefire or agreement ending US-Iran hostilities, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: The US and Iranian governments do not both announce or confirm a ceasefire or hostilities-ending agreement between 2026-10-08 and 2026-12-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The S&P 500 closes at or below 7000.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-10-08 and 2026-12-31 (reference: 7,777.51 on the packet date).
resolution: TRUE if FRED series SP500 shows a daily close at or below 7000.00 on any trading day between 2026-10-08 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 7,777.51 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 closes above 7000.00 on every trading day from 2026-10-08 through 2026-12-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield prints at or above 5.50 percent on at least one day between 2026-10-08 and 2026-12-31 (reference: 5.30 percent on the packet date).

failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield stays below 5.50 percent on every business day from 2026-10-08 through 2026-12-31.
